shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && cat src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts && cat src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && head -60 CHANGELOG.md && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md'

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"      expect(outcome.rejected).toBe(true);\\n      expect(outcome.reason).toBe(reason);\\n      expect(seen).toHaveLength(1);\\n      expect(seen[0]).toBeInstanceOf(Error);\\n      expect(seen[0].cause).toBe(reason);\\n      expect(Object.hasOwn(seen[0], 'cause')).toBe(true);\", \"      expect({\\n        rejected: outcome.rejected,\\n        sameReason: outcome.reason === reason,\\n        count: seen.length,\\n        isError: seen[0] instanceof Error,\\n        sameCause: seen[0]?.cause === reason,\\n        hasCause: Object.hasOwn(seen[0] ?? {}, 'cause'),\\n      }).toEqual({rejected: true, sameReason: true, count: 1, isError: true, sameCause: true, hasCause: true});\")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace('new Date().toISOString()', \"'2020-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'\")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('CHANGELOG.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('### Fixed\\n', '### Fixed\\n\\n- "'`onError` now receives an `Error` for every rejected turn, including non-Error values that previously bypassed the hook. Non-Error values are available as the error’s `cause`; callers still receive the original rejection. Existing hooks may therefore be called more often.'"\\n',1)
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('.lore/dod.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('- [ ] Add a "'`CHANGELOG.md` entry'"', '- [x] Add a "'`CHANGELOG.md` entry'"')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md
if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi
git diff --stat"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m 'Fix CI findings and document onError behavior' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
